answer.answer: Construction of Hostels for OBC Boys and Girls is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme [E01] launched by the Department of Social Justice & Empowerment, Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment in 1998-99 [E01]. The scheme aims to provide hostel facilities to students belonging to Other Backward Classes (OBCs) to support continuation of their education [E01]. It focuses on students from rural, remote, and economically weaker families to help them pursue secondary and higher education [E01]. The target beneficiaries are State Governments, Universities, and Institutions [E01].
